videos.prompt:
Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC product video, 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld phone camera, natural home lighting.

Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Product truth from references: Bedsure Cooling Thin & Thick Mat for Dogs. The product is a passive pet cooling mat, not an electric device. It is a pale ice blue thin rectangular dog mat with rounded corners, white edge piping, soft wave quilting across the top surface, a lightly padded thin profile, and a light gray dotted non-slip underside if the back is visible. A small blue edge tag may appear. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve the mat material, edge shape, stitching, wave quilting, underside dotted texture, and thin profile. Use the function reference image only to understand the real product usage. Do not invent new functions.

Scene: a real home living room on a warm day. The floor area where the dog usually rests looks slightly uncomfortable and inconvenient: a golden retriever is shifting on the bare hardwood floor near soft sunlight, with a regular rug nearby that looks warm and rumpled. Keep the dog calm and safe, never distressed or overheated.

Timeline:
0-2s: Show one messy, dirty, inconvenient, or problem environment in a real-life setting. Show a stable medium overview of the warm-looking pet rest area in the living room. The golden retriever is lying or shifting on the bare hardwood floor beside the rumpled rug, looking mildly uncomfortable and unable to settle. The viewer immediately understands the problem: the dog needs a more comfortable cool-to-the-touch resting spot.
2-4s: Cut to one close-up of the most annoying pain detail. Show the dog's paw and chest shifting against the bare floor next to the warm-looking rumpled rug, with subtle loose fur on the floor and the dog not fully relaxed. Show the texture of the floor, fur, paw, and rug edge clearly. Do not show unsafe pet behavior.
4-5s product reveal: Show one short product reveal for a single instant. Use product appearance shot only. Show the Bedsure cooling mat clearly as a short solution cue. The pale ice blue quilted mat appears laid flat in the same room for a quick cut-in shot. Do not show the product held close to the camera, moving close to the camera, moving toward the dog, touching the dog, or performing a full usage process. This is only a one-second product appearance reveal.
5-8s: Return to the same environment as the opening problem overview. Return to the same living room floor area with the same general camera angle and similar natural lighting. The same dog now rests calmly on the pale ice blue mat. The space looks more comfortable, tidier, and more settled, but realistic, not magically perfect. The mat remains thin, flat, rectangular, rounded at the corners, with white piping and wave quilting visible.
8-10s: Show the product appearance beside the improved environment. Show the product appearance beside the improved pet rest area while the relaxed dog or the tidy living room remains visible behind or next to it. The mat must match the reference images exactly: pale ice blue top, white piping, soft wave quilting, thin lightly padded profile, rounded rectangular shape. If a corner is folded, show the light gray dotted non-slip underside accurately. Do not block the improved result.

Keep the pacing fast, realistic, and product-focused. Use realistic phone-shot UGC style, handheld but stable. No voiceover, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no price tags, no platform UI, no stickers, no arrows, no fake product cards, no watermarks.

Do not claim medical effects, heatstroke treatment, guaranteed cooling, permanent temperature reduction, antibacterial effects, or safety for every situation. You may visually suggest a calmer, more comfortable rest area, but do not invent active refrigeration or dramatic cooling effects.

Negative prompt: Do not show unrealistic instant transformation. Do not make discomfort disappear magically. Do not change the room, floor, lighting, layout, dog, or general camera angle between the problem overview and the improved overview. Do not replace the product with a blanket, electric pad, thick dog bed, dog bed with high walls, crate, cushion sofa, cooling fan, or gel mat. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, edge piping, quilting pattern, thin flat profile, or underside texture. Do not add gel, water filling, power supply, batteries, temperature display, fan, cord, switch, zippers, straps, extra labels, decorative paw prints, cartoon graphics, or unconfirmed accessories. Do not show the product held close to the camera. Do not show the product moving close to the camera. Do not show the product moving toward, touching, pressing, wiping, brushing, or scraping the pain area during the 4-5s product reveal. Do not show waiting reaction during the 4-5s product reveal. Do not show long hand movement, folding, washing, brushing, wiping, or a complete usage process. Do not show distressed, unsafe, or overheated animal behavior. Do not invent unsupported claims such as 100%, guaranteed, permanent, medical, antibacterial, or safe for every situation.
videos.negative_prompt: Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, edge piping, quilting pattern, thin flat profile, or underside texture. Do not invent electric, gel, fan, cord, medical, antibacterial, or guaranteed cooling features.
